Recipe for simple sweet potato leaves

Sweat potatoes have been taking over my garden so I’ve been playing with recipes for the leaves, which are (perhaps contrary to intuition) quite edible. This time I sautéed them in olive oil and with Costco lakeshore seasoning. That has garlic, salt, pepper, shallot etc. and is a really useful staple for veggies, fish, and chicken. Anyway I cooked it up for a few minutes like spinach and ate with eggs and brown rice. Enjoyable!
